Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 3.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1258
Claimant:
Amy Anderson
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
12/23/2023
Reported a left-turn collision at an intersection. The insured was turning left when a vehicle coming the other way
struck the driver's side of the insured's car, and the insured's policy was confirmed as active at the time of loss.
12/27/2023
Spoke with the insured, who described the same sequence of events as in the first report: a green light, a gap in
oncoming traffic, and a sudden impact. The insured is listed as the named driver on the policy.
12/31/2023
Obtained the police report, which lists the claimant as a passenger in the insured's vehicle and notes two
independent witnesses at the scene. Both witnesses describe the other vehicle entering the intersection against a red
signal.
01/04/2024
Took photos of both vehicles. The damage to the insured's driver-side door and the other car's front bumper lines up
with the angle and speed described in the statements.
01/23/2024
The other driver's insurer accepted liability in principle and proivded its own statement, which matches the account
given by the insured and by the witnesses on the key points.
02/25/2024
Received notice that the claimant has retained an attorney, who has asked that all further contact go through that
office. Future communications will be routed accordingly.
03/25/2024
The claimant's attorney submitted a treatment summary reporting a neck strain. The injury is consistent with the type
of side impact described, and the treatment plan reflects a standard course for this kind of soft-tissue complaint.
04/10/2024
Reviewed the medical records, which show no prior treatment to the neck or upper back. The claimant's history on file
is clean for that body area.
04/19/2024
Noted a few faint scratches on the insured's rear quarter panel during the vehicle inspection. These may predate this
collision, so the repair estimate will be reviewed to separate any old marks from new damage.
05/01/2024
Checked the coverage history and found that the policy was in force well before the loss and that nothing points to
damage occurring before the coverage start. The claim remains on the standard handling track.
05/29/2024
Treatment has tapered as the claimant improved, with fewer visits in recent records and a notation that the claimant is
returning to normal daily activity. The attorney has been informed that the file is progressing normally.
07/22/2024
Current status: liability is supported by the police report, witness statements, photos, and the other driver's statement.
The bodily injury claim is under review pending the final treatment report and settlement discussions with the
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
